passages.note: Every section of the act concerns firearms, and it repeals the carry licensing sections outright ("IC 35-47-2-2 IS REPEALED", "IC 35-47-2-24 IS REPEALED"), so the vote is not multi-subject.
The page lists Lucas as a co-author of the enrolled bill, a second act of his on the same instrument.

rows.reasoning: Lucas voted Yea on the conference committee report for HB 1296 (2022) and is listed as a co-author of the enrolled bill, which states "IC 35-47-2-2 IS REPEALED" and provides that an adult who is "not otherwise prohibited from carrying or possessing a handgun" is "not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana." That matches the rung "Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit" clause for clause. It excludes "at most loosen rules on carrying, such as honoring permits across state lines", because the act abolishes the carry permit requirement rather than loosening rules around a permit that remains.
